BARDICDICE.Title: Bardic Dice
BARDICDICE.ServerDown: ACE-Step server unreachable — is the sidecar running?
BARDICDICE.BreakStarted: On break — composing your recap ballad…
BARDICDICE.DirgeStarted: The music falls silent — composing a dirge for the fallen…
BARDICDICE.OnlyGM: Only the GM can control Bardic Dice generation.

Settings.AceBaseUrlHint: Base URL of the ACE-Step 1.5 api_server sidecar (GM machine). Default http://127.0.0.1:8001
Settings.AceApiKeyHint: Leave blank if ACESTEP_API_KEY is not set on the sidecar.
Settings.ThinkingHint: Lets the 5 Hz LM expand captions/lyrics and fill missing BPM/key metadata.
Settings.AutoCombatHint: Switch to the faster combat profile when combat starts, back to tavern when it ends.
Settings.VocalLanguageHint: English only — enforced in code; this setting is ignored.
Settings.IncludeSecret: Include Secret/GM Rolls in the Muse
Settings.IncludeSecretHint: Off by default: whispers and secret rolls never steer the music or leave the table.
Settings.SummarizerEnabledHint: Off by default. When on, the session log (actor names, rolls, public chat) is sent to the endpoint below to write break verses. The built-in template ballad is used otherwise.
Settings.SummarizerBaseUrlHint: e.g. http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 for Ollama, or https://api.openai.com/v1
Settings.SmallLlmEnabled: Small LLM Lyric & Joke Writer + Story Tracker
Settings.SmallLlmEnabledHint: A super-small local LLM rewrites verses and bridge jokes fresh each song from the latest dice facts and the all-time story tracker (grimdark comedy, original parodies only — no copied lyrics). Only actor names/careers, roll results and stats are sent to the endpoint below, never raw chat. Falls back to built-in words when unreachable.
Settings.SmallLlmBaseUrlHint: Default is local Ollama. Run sidecar/setup-llm.sh once to install it and pull the tiny model.
Settings.SmallLlmModelHint: Keep it tiny and fast, e.g. llama3.2:1b or qwen2.5:1.5b.
Settings.UploadFolderHint: Folder (under the Foundry data source) where generated MP3s are uploaded so players can hear them.
Settings.JournalRecap: Save Break Recaps to a Journal
Settings.CorruptionStingHint: Play a short discordant sting for everyone when an actor gains a Corruption point, and sour the next track briefly.
Settings.DeathDirgeHint: When a player character dies — Wounds/HP reach 0, a Dead condition lands, Critical Wounds pass their maximum, a fatal Critical Wound is applied, or the combatant is marked Defeated — stop the set and sing a slow dirge naming the fallen character and their career, then resume. NPC deaths never trigger it.
Settings.BridgeDurationHint: Long instrumental bridges loop between vocal songs (and across tavern/combat style changes) to pad time while the next song composes.
Settings.BridgeLibraryHint: Play pregenerated lively plucky-lute interludes from the <upload folder>/library (see sidecar/pregenerate-bridges.mjs) instead of generating bridges live. Falls back to live generation when the library is empty.
Settings.PlayerRequestsHint: Players can type requests in chat — "!bard sing about dragons, faster, for Aria!" — and the bards answer in chat and steer the next song (tempo, mood, topic, dedication, instrumental).
Settings.ParodyEnabledHint: Always on: the parody writer is the core lyric writer for every song — tavern, combat, dirges and break ballads. It picks a song skeleton from your local LRCLIB dump (source words never leave the GM machine) and the tiny LLM writes original grimdark words on it with your dice facts; drafts sharing a line or 5-word run with the source are refused. Falls back to the template/LLM writers when unreachable. Clear the Parody Writer URL to disable.
Settings.ParodyBaseUrlHint: Default is the local parody sidecar, started by sidecar/start-all.sh (needs lrclib.sqlite3 — see sidecar/README.md).
